caption:
Даже маленький балкон может стать уютным уголком круглый год. Делаем безрамное остекление и перголы по всей стране. Напишите СТЕКЛО в WhatsApp. #остеклениебалкона #безрамноеостекление #пергола #израиль

👉 reels.tepexa.com/w/5347ab92bdba713bdb58
why: Серия «Балкон + пергола»: механика «пара метров как отдельный мир» из донора с 6,2 млн просмотров и ваш лучший ролик балкон+пергола (47 359). Цель — охват и заявки на остекление.
rules: Roman Group (ArtVitrage) works ONLY with glass. Main product (about 2 of 3 videos): frameless glazing of balconies and verandas (windows for balconies), pergolas, balcony blinds. Also: stained glass, decorative mirrors, glass kitchen backsplashes (skinali), glass partitions. EVERY shot must clearly show glass work as the main subject. Forbidden shots: kitchens or rooms where cabinets, appliances or furniture are the subject and no glass is clearly visible in focus; furniture or cabinets being built or assembled; woodwork; drinking glasses, glassware, bottles or jars; tiles, plaster or other trades; mosques, churches and religious images (synagogue stained glass only from his own photos). Never mention furniture. No prices, no deadlines, no client names, no other companies' objects.

problems: Frames 5, 6 and 7 (5.8–8.4s) are almost identical static shots of the same balcony facade, so the video feels frozen
Frame 4 (4.5s) repeats the same facade, adding to the long static stretch
The first frame is a wide facade with a small text card, so it is weak at stopping the thumb
The hook text is repeated on three frames in a row (1.9s, 3.2s) and sits over the building and the person's body area
Subtitles 'Израиле.' and 'Напишите СТЕКЛО в' overlap the man's hand and torso, and the 'Напишите СТЕКЛО в' frame lacks the 'WhatsApp' continuation
qa.fix: Replace the repeated facade frames with varied close-ups of glass panels sliding, an interior view from the finished glazed balcony, and a before/after, and put the subtitles away from the man's body with a stronger CTA end card.
